notes: נָתְנוּ and יָד are fused into submitted themselves rather than leaving the noun unrepresented, which rule 30 forbids for a morpheme whose sense the ASV has written inside its rendering; the reflexive is part of the English verb's own rendering under rule 44, so no morpheme owns a part of the pair.
The single the of all the sons of king David is fronted from the article on הַמֶּלֶךְ, the rectum being rendered anarthrously (rule 29).
